abilities.name: water-absorb
abilities.effect: Absorbs water moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.

abilities.name: hydration
abilities.effect: Cures any major status ailment after each turn during rain.

kanto.flavorText: A POKéMON that has been overhunted almost to extinction. It can ferry people on its back.

original-johto.flavorText: This gentle POKéMON loves to give people rides and provides a ve­ ry comfortable way to get around.

hoenn.flavorText: People have driven LAPRAS almost to the point of extinction. In the evenings, it is said to sing plaintively as it seeks what few others of its kind still remain.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It loves crossing the sea with people and Pokémon on its back. It understands human speech.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: It loves crossing the sea with people and Pokémon on its back. It understands human speech.

updated-johto.flavorText: It ferries people across the sea on its back. It may sing an enchanting cry if it is in a good mood.

original-unova.flavorText: It loves crossing the sea with people and Pokémon on its back. It understands human speech.

updated-unova.flavorText: Able to understand human speech and very intelligent, it loves to swim in the sea with people on its back.

kalos.flavorText: Its high intelligence enables it to understand human speech. It likes to ferry people on its back.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: People have driven Lapras almost to the point of extinction. In the evenings, this Pokémon is said to sing plaintively as it seeks what few others of its kind still remain.

original-alola.flavorText: These Pokémon were once near extinction due to poaching. Following protective regulations, there is now an overabundance of them.

updated-alola.flavorText: They’ve been so cherished that there’s now an overabundance. The fish Pokémon population has declined in waters with too many Lapras.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: A gentle soul that can understand human speech. It can ferry people across the sea on its back.

swsh.flavorText: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.
